The requested human-led workflow qualifies; the journal-specific LLM guidance requires documentation and human accountability.

disclosure.instructions: Document LLM use in Methods or an appropriate alternative. Journal guidelines exempt copy editing alone, while publisher guidance calls for its declaration; follow the stricter publisher guidance.

ai_policy.summary: Elsevier policy explicitly allows literature support, research methods including analysis and code, and drafting with human intellectual contribution. Its separate author factsheet checklist says AI should not write substantive content, creating a material ambiguity; the journal guide was blocked, so journal-specific restrictions could not be checked.

disclosure.instructions: Put a separate declaration immediately before references naming tool, purpose and human oversight; document research and code use in Methods with reproducibility details. Basic spelling, grammar and punctuation checks do not require declaration.

restrictions: Human authors must verify and edit outputs and retain responsibility and scientific judgment.
No fabrication or alteration of research data or references; primary research images and graphical abstracts have specific restrictions.
Publisher factsheet checklist says AI did not write substantive content, while policy permits drafting with genuine intellectual contribution; journal-specific rules inaccessible.
